import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from helpers import *
D=np.load('base_feats.npz'); y=D['y']
c11=D['cls11'].astype(np.float64); m11=D['mean11'].astype(np.float64)
M=np.load('M_v1.npy').astype(np.float64)
X=c11+m11@M.T
Pc = X - X.mean(1,keepdims=True); Ln = Pc/ Pc.std(1,keepdims=True)
L='bert.encoder.layer.11.'
I=np.eye(768,dtype=np.float32); z768=np.zeros(768,np.float32)
save_edit(L+'attention.self.query.weight', np.zeros((768,768),np.float32))
save_edit(L+'attention.self.query.bias', z768)
save_edit(L+'attention.self.value.weight', I)
save_edit(L+'attention.self.value.bias', z768)
save_edit(L+'attention.output.dense.weight', M.astype(np.float32))
save_edit(L+'attention.output.dense.bias', z768)
save_edit(L+'attention.output.LayerNorm.weight', np.ones(768,np.float32))
save_edit(L+'attention.output.LayerNorm.bias', z768)
save_edit(L+'output.dense.weight', np.zeros((768,3072),np.float32))
save_edit(L+'output.dense.bias', z768)
save_edit(L+'output.LayerNorm.weight', np.ones(768,np.float32))
save_edit(L+'output.LayerNorm.bias', z768)
s=0.5
save_edit('bert.pooler.dense.weight', (s*I).astype(np.float32))
save_edit('bert.pooler.dense.bias', (-s*Ln.mean(0)).astype(np.float32))
np.save('LN_est_v1.npy', Ln.astype(np.float32))
print(edits())
with open('notes.md','a') as f: f.write("""- Base CV (5-fold, LDA/ridge closed form): mean11 ~0.969, cls12 0.945, cls11+mean11 concat 0.975, mean0+mean11+cls11 ~0.983 (ceiling of combos).
- v1 edit (run13): layer11 Q=0 (uniform attn), V=I, O=M (M_v1.npy = 2I + pinv(A)(B-2A), A,B ridge(lam100) on [cls11,mean11]),
  LNs gamma1 beta0, FFN out zeroed -> final CLS = LN(cls11 + M mean11). Pooler 0.5*I, bias -0.5*mean(LN est). Classifier still zero.
  Next: read pooled of edited model for all practice (2 passes), fit ridge/LDA head.
""")
